title: Weekend Housework at Home
audience: Chinese primary school students (10-12 years old, average level in mainland China)
imageAlt: A family doing weekend housework at home, with a big chore chart listing each person's job
imageDescription: A warm living room on the weekend. A big green board in the center shows a CHORE CHART with four lines: MEI - SWEEP with a broom icon, DAD - COOK with a red pot icon, MUM - CLEAN with a window icon, and GRANDPA - REST with a steaming tea cup icon. On the left, Mei, a girl in blue overalls and a yellow shirt, sweeps the wooden floor with a big broom; a small pile of dust and one dirty white sock lie on the floor near the broom. Behind her, Mum stands on a wooden stool in pink top and green apron, wiping the window with a blue cloth. On the right, Dad in a yellow apron stirs a steaming red pot on the kitchen stove. Grandpa, in brown sweater and glasses, sits in a green armchair reading a newspaper and raising one finger. An orange cat sleeps on a blue sofa. A potted plant, yellow curtains and a sunny window fill the background.
scoringDescription: A bright cartoon living room during weekend housework. The central element is a large green board titled CHORE CHART listing four assignments, each with an icon: MEI - SWEEP (broom), DAD - COOK (red cooking pot), MUM - CLEAN (window), GRANDPA - REST (steaming tea cup). Left: Mei, a schoolgirl with a ponytail, yellow shirt and blue overalls, sweeps the wooden floor with a straw broom held in both hands; under the broom is a small pile of dust and beside it a single dirty white sock with grey heel. Behind her, Mum, in a pink top, blue trousers, green apron and pink slippers, stands on a two-step wooden stool and cleans the window with a blue cloth; outside the window the sky is blue with clouds and trees. Right: Dad, in a blue shirt and yellow apron, stands at the kitchen stove stirring a steaming red pot with a wooden spoon. Below him, Grandpa, with grey hair, glasses and brown sweater, sits in a green armchair reading an open newspaper with one finger raised, smiling. An orange tabby cat curls asleep on a yellow cushion on the blue sofa between Grandpa and the chore chart. A potted plant sits on a small cabinet at the far left, and yellow polka-dot curtains frame the window. Accept any reasonable wording; the chart text and who-is-doing-what are the key evidence. For questions about icons, the pot matches DAD - COOK and the tea cup matches GRANDPA - REST. Grandpa rests because the chart assigns him REST, which students may explain as he is old and the family cares for him. Mei has not finished sweeping: dust and the sock are still on the floor. The cat is not helping; it sleeps on the sofa.
